[[Present your scholarly dissertation->Valedictorian Ending]] [[Defy the tribunal's conservative edict->Exiled Ending]] You graduate at the summit of Aurelian Academy with highest honors and prestige. Cast out from the academy gates, you depart into the wide world to forge your own path.
